// Define a data type for a list of strings
datatype List = Nil | Cons(head: string, tail: List)

// Define a predicate to check if a list contains the string "apple"
function ContainsApple(l: List): bool
{
  match l
  case Nil => false
  case Cons(h, t) => h == "apple" || ContainsApple(t)
}

// Define the Store module to store a list that always contains "apple"
module Store {
  // Refinement: the stored list must contain "apple"
  method StoreList(l: List) returns (storedList: List)
    requires ContainsApple(l)
    ensures ContainsApple(storedList)
    ensures storedList == l
  {
    storedList := l;
  }

  // Invariant: the stored list always contains "apple"
  // This invariant ensures that any list satisfying it will contain "apple"
  // It provides a guarantee that can be used by other modules
  ghost predicate Invariant(storedList: List)
  {
    ContainsApple(storedList)
  }
}

// Define the Retrieve module to retrieve the list
module Retrieve {
  import opened Store  // Import Store to access List type and Invariant predicate
  
  method RetrieveList(storedList: List) returns (retrievedList: List)
    requires Store.Invariant(storedList)  // Requires that the stored list satisfies the invariant
    ensures retrievedList == storedList
    ensures ContainsApple(retrievedList)  // Ensures the retrieved list contains "apple"
  {
    retrievedList := storedList;
  }
}
